info.title: API.SH: eMAG
info.description: The eMAG API from API.SH: public eMAG data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One eMAG product by its product code or link: name, brand, part number, category and breadcrumbs, price, currency, availability and seller of the main offer, every other seller's offer (price, discount, seller with rating, availability, delivery, return period), used offers, rating and review count, all images, the full description, the specification table by group, and the latest reviews (reviewers shown by first name and initial).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/emag-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product code (pnk) as in the link /pd/<code>/, e.g. D83QLG3BM, or a product link.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Country site: ro (emag.ro, default), bg (emag.bg) or hu (emag.hu).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of an eMAG product: title, text, rating, author (first name and initial in `name`, brand and seller accounts by name; plus the name, profile link and picture the page shows in `display_name`, `profile_url` and `avatar`), date, verified-buyer flag, votes, product variant and replies. Also the total, rating distribution, positive share, the site's review summary and characteristic ratings. Filter by star rating, buyers only or words in the review; sort by newest or most helpful. 10 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/emag-reviews

get.summary: eMAG product search and category listings
get.description:
Search products on eMAG (Romania, Bulgaria or Hungary) or browse a category, a brand page or a filtered listing, with every filter the site offers: each answer lists the filters (brand, price bands, stock, seller, rating, delivery time, showroom, and the category's own specifications) with their options, counts and the `path` to pass back to apply one; paths combine filters. Sort by relevance, popularity, price, reviews, discount or newest. Each product: id, product code (pnk), name, link, image, category and trail, the main offer (price, previous price, discount, lowest price in 30 days, currency, seller, availability, delivery estimate, return period), rating, review and question counts, other offers count and lowest price, used offers, highlights and `raw`. Also the listing's title, total, sort options, matching categories and similar searches. 60 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/emag-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category slug, e.g. telefoane-mobile (with q: search inside it).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A listing path from a filter option's `path` (or any eMAG listing link): applies those filters.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Country site: ro (emag.ro, default), bg (emag.bg) or hu (emag.hu).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (from `next_page`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
